component.name: Audio Engine V10
component.summary: Audiophile music player with 10-band GStreamer equalizer and 64-band RTA spectrum

description.p: Audio Engine V10 is an audiophile-grade desktop music player and digital signal processing suite built in Rust with pure GTK 4 and GStreamer.
Engineered for high fidelity, low resource consumption, and immediate responsiveness, it pairs hardware-accelerated playback with real-time acoustics analysis and distortion prevention.

ul.li: 10-band graphic studio equalizer (-12 dB to +12 dB) with instant presets (Warm Vintage, Bass Boost, Modern Clean, Vocal Enhancer, Club Master, Flat)
Smart anti-clipping auto-headroom protection that dynamically prevents digital distortion during heavy bass and gain boosts
Real-time 64-band logarithmic RTA spectrum visualizer with floating peak-hold indicators
Custom studio skins (Frost Light, Dark Elegance, Cyberpunk Neon, Warm Vintage Studio, Matrix Emerald, Tokyo Night)
Fast playlist and media library with live search filter, Drag and Drop support, and persistent state

screenshot.caption: Main player window with 64-band logarithmic RTA spectrum visualizer and Frost Light skin

description.p: Production release of Audio Engine V10 powered by pure GTK 4 and GStreamer, offering hardware-accelerated graphics, 10-band equalizer studio, 64-band RTA spectrum visualizer with peak hold, six studio skins, and complete session persistence.
